signal_semantics.S01: long when log(close_t/close_{t-L})>0; cadence month_end samples the state on the last session of each month and holds
signal_semantics.S04: enter when close_t > max(close_{t-entry..t-1}); exit when close_t < min(close_{t-exit..t-1})
signal_semantics.S05: Cutler simple-mean RSI(period); enter RSI<entry_below (and trend filter); exit RSI>exit_above
signal_semantics.S06: z=(close-mean)/std(ddof=1) over lookback; enter z<=entry_z (and trend filter); exit z>=0
signal_semantics.S07: event: close_{t-d}-close_t >= mult*ATR_{t-1} (simple-mean ATR, prior bar) and trend filter; held for `hold` strategy outputs
signal_semantics.S08: event: open_t - close_{t-1} <= -mult*ATR_{t-1}; decision only after bar t completes; held for `hold` strategy outputs
signal_semantics.S09: enter when range(short)/range(long) at t-1 <= ratio and close_t > prior-breakout close channel (and trend filter); exit below prior exit channel
signal_semantics.S10: long while close_t >= (1-distance)*max(close, high_lookback); cadence as S01
signal_semantics.S11: event: `down_sessions` consecutive down closes (and trend filter); held for `hold` strategy outputs
signal_semantics.S12: event: volume z-score vs prior L bars >= volume_z with price impulse sign (continuation up / reversal down); long only
signal_semantics.S13: event: std(short)/std(long) of log returns >= ratio with up-day (breakout) or down-day (reversal); long only
signal_semantics.S14: member(bar t+2) so the held close-to-close return covers a member session: turn-of-month last/first sessions, or Nov-Apr
